reason: Baseline: importing the sample deck creates/opens the collection at the fixed path <AnkiDroid directory>/collection.anki2, which DeckPicker opens on every start (firstCollectionOpen).

needs_state: data: a deck exists in the collection (the user created or imported one)
reason: Baseline: the imported sample deck is itself a deck in the collection; the gated screens act on the selected deck.

needs_state: settings: the preference is set to the value the route needs
reason: One generic text covers 28 distinct edges with different underlying conditions (TTS engine/locales, reviewer display options, widget/notification toggles). The imported-deck baseline sets none of them, and some are not a preference value at all (TTS availability), so the text is not baseline-satisfied on every edge and cannot be cleared as a whole.

reason: Baseline + ordinary GUI: the field controller is chosen from the edited field's type; the imported deck's notes have text fields, and editing one creates the BasicTextFieldController and its pronounce button.

reason: The baseline deck is a regular deck (dyn == 0). A filtered (dyn) deck must be created first, which is extra collection data beyond the imported sample deck.

reason: A process/session precondition (a stored dialog message handled in-process; the widget update service), not collection data. The imported-deck baseline does not by itself guarantee a second in-process visit.

needs_state: account: an AnkiWeb account is logged in (hkey stored)
reason: Logged-in state is a non-empty hkey preference, written only by an AnkiWeb login with real credentials; not part of the baseline.

reason: Baseline: the imported deck's cards are generated from notes, so at least one note exists; the gated actions operate on an existing note / the current card (edit-existing-note menu items, bury/suspend of the current card).

reason: The .apkg arrives from outside the app (another app's intent / picked file); the baseline import does not leave an .apkg pending for these dialog routes. Outside-data case, not a W2 baseline gate.
